subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N54 across all 1 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N54 in BMW badging is concentrated on the Z4 sDrive35i (E89, 2009–2016).

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with hybrid-system ancillaries additionally accounted for on MHEV/PHEV applications.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The N54 is well-documented for high-pressure fuel pump and injector issues, turbocharger wastegate rattle, and carbon buildup on intake valves — all of which we inspect as standard during a rebuild.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed N54 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
